description: Seven-day time grid view with configurable first day of week, slot duration, resource grouping, and drag-and-drop. Delegates rendering to TmSchedulerTimeGrid, so a timed event is a tinted card with a coloured left stripe and an all-day event keeps its solid fill. Column headers are sentence case.

parameters.name: CurrentDate
parameters.description: Currently displayed date (any day in the target week).

parameters.name: FirstDayOfWeek
parameters.description: First day of week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, ...).

parameters.name: Events
parameters.description: Events to display.

parameters.name: SlotDuration
parameters.description: Duration of each time slot in minutes.

parameters.name: OnSlotClick
parameters.description: Fires when a time slot is clicked.

parameters.name: SelectedDate
parameters.description: The selected day, forwarded to the time grid.

parameters.name: SelectedEvent
parameters.description: The selected event, forwarded to the time grid.

parameters.name: SelectedEventChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user selects an event.

parameters.name: OnEventClick
parameters.description: Fires when an event is clicked.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether events are read-only.

parameters.name: OnEventChanged
parameters.description: Fires when an event is moved or resized.

parameters.name: OnSlotContextMenu
parameters.description: Fires when right-clicking on a time slot.

parameters.name: OnEventContextMenu
parameters.description: Fires when right-clicking on an event.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description: Resources for grouping columns.

parameters.name: EventTemplate
parameters.description: Optional custom event template.

parameters.name: HideTimeGrid
parameters.description: When true, hides the hourly time grid body.

parameters.name: Today
parameters.description: Today in the display zone. The matching column gets tm-scheduler-timegrid-col--today.

parameters.name: HighlightWeekends
parameters.description: When true, Saturday and Sunday columns get tm-scheduler-timegrid-col--weekend.

parameters.name: AllDayEventStyle
parameters.description: Paint of an all-day event, forwarded to the time grid.

parameters.name: WeekDays
parameters.description: Which days the week renders. WorkWeek keeps the first five.

parameters.name: WorkDayStart
parameters.description: First minute of the working day, forwarded to the time grid.

parameters.name: WorkDayEnd
parameters.description: Last minute of the working day, forwarded to the time grid.

parameters.name: ShowFullDay
parameters.description: When false the grid shows only the working hours, forwarded to the time grid.

parameters.name: HighlightOffHours
parameters.description: When true, hours outside the working day are tinted, forwarded to the time grid.

parameters.name: ScrollToTime
parameters.description: When set, the grid scrolls this time into view after the first render, forwarded to the time grid.

parameters.name: ShowNowIndicator
parameters.description: When true today's column draws the current-time indicator, forwarded to the time grid.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: Display zone for the current-time indicator, forwarded to the time grid.

parameters.name: ResourceHeaderTemplate
parameters.description: Replaces the default resource header, forwarded to the time grid.

parameters.name: ShowEventResource
parameters.description: When true a timed event names its resource, forwarded to the time grid.

examples.title: Week view with 15-minute slots
examples.code: <TmSchedulerWeekView CurrentDate="DateTime.Today" Events="@_events" FirstDayOfWeek="1" SlotDuration="15" OnSlotClick="@HandleSlotClick" OnEventClick="@HandleEventClick" />
